summary: DjangoLux 1.17.0 runtime: pages run only the scripts the server signs, the stack follows Composer 1.11 (no Docker proxy, snapshot Redis), and sessions survive a cache outage.
highlights: Updated the application framework to DjangoLux 1.17.0; it needs Composer 1.11.0 and the new stack files (run ./start.sh check --fix once).
Every page runs only scripts the server signs and no inline styles, so injected script cannot run and the office security scan passes.
Redis keeps its data in snapshots, so a damaged log file can no longer stop the whole system from starting.
A short cache outage no longer signs everyone out.
The Docker proxy service is gone; Composer reads container state itself.
Deployments can limit which updates the application may request (DLUX_UPDATE_POLICY).
